meta.title: Sign in — Tracecart
meta.description: Sign in to your Tracecart workspace.

subtitle: Sign in to your workspace to continue.

noAccount.title: This account doesn't have access to Tracecart
noAccount.body: You're signed in, but no Tracecart workspace is linked to this email address. Ask an administrator to add you, or sign in with a different account.

unavailable.title: We can't sign you in right now
unavailable.body: Your identity couldn't be verified. Try again in a moment; if it keeps happening, contact an administrator.

mfaRequired.title: Turn on two-step verification
mfaRequired.body: Staff accounts need a second step to sign in. Turn on two-step verification in your account, then sign out and back in.

tagline: The place to buy tools, delivered to hard-to-reach markets.
